provenance_disclosure.checkpoint_identity_explanation: The exploratory checkpoint directories checkpoints/resonance_qwen_sft and checkpoints/resonance_qwen_rl share identical LoRA adapter weight binaries (SHA-256: 22582b459d3523fc60ba7f7ec3afaf9792ec7b74e336fc75c26c5dcd74d459cd). The reported SFT and RL outcome rows reflect two independent stochastic evaluation passes (T=0.7, top_p=0.8) under this adapter across the 50 locked worlds, rather than two separate post-training weight states. Stored outcomes reflect rollout sampling variance and must not be cited as an established empirical post-training effect.
provenance_disclosure.algorithm: Group-Relative Policy Gradient (REINFORCE with group advantage baselines and GRPO-style normalization; no PPO ratio clipping or ref KL)
